Enemies hit: Decreases Attack Speed -666 and Move Speed -60%, and increases Cast Time +60%. Lasts 3sec. Grants 1 stack of Bloodthirst for each target hit, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. Shadowplay Venom Blades (Rank 2) Abyssal Charges 2 Range: Caster only Effect Range: 10 m Melee Attack +180% Instant 14sec Cooldown Effect Granted Deadly Poison Inflicts (varies) Magic damage for 11sec, ignoring Magic Defense. Duration: 11sec Throws venomous knives at all enemies within a 10m radius, dealing an initial (302 + 180% Melee Attack) Physical Damage and inflicting the Deadly Poison debuff. Inflicts 289-374 Magic damage for 11sec, ignoring Magic Defense. Shadowplay Rising Hatred (Rank 1) Abyssal Charges 2 ~ 4 Range: Caster only Instant 2min Cooldown Effect Granted Fury Increases max Abyssal Charge +2. Adds 2 Abyssal Charges when a skill that increases charges is used. Charges do not decrease naturally. Duration: 6sec Increases maximum Abyssal Charges +2 for 12 seconds. Prevents charges from naturally depleting for the duration, and doubles charges gained through using skills. Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration. Shadowplay Assassination (Rank 1) Abyssal Charges 4 ~ 6 Range: Caster only Instant 10sec Cooldown Effect Granted Assassination Shadowplay damage increased +12%, and you cannot be targeted by any enemies for the duration. Duration: 2sec Increases Shadowplay Skill Damage by +12% for 4sec, and causes the caster to become impossible to target during that time. Can only be used when the caster is invisible. Additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, extending the duration to a maximum of 8sec. Passive Passive Skill Evasive Counterstrike Triggers a counterattack when a Melee Attack is evaded. Stacks 2 Bloodthirst when attacked. This ability has a 12 sec cooldown once triggered. Unlocks once 2 skill points are spent in Shadowplay. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Consecutive Evasion Increases Melee Evasion +18% for 7 seconds after a successful Evasion against melee attacks. Unlocks once 4 skill points are spent in Shadowplay. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Disregard Permanently decreases Aggro generation -20%. Unlocks once 6 skill points are spent in Shadowplay. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Loophole Decreases received Ranged Damage -30% for 3 seconds after receiving a Ranged Critical Hit. This ability has a 20 sec cooldown once triggered. Unlocks once 7 skill points are spent in Shadowplay. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Piercing Increases Melee and Ranged Critical Rates +10% and Attack Speed +31 for 8 seconds after a successful Melee or Ranged Critical hit. Unlocks once 8 skill points are spent in Shadowplay. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Bloodthirst Intensified Doubles the amount of Bloodthirst granted by Shadowplay skills. Unlocks once 9 skill points are spent in Shadowplay. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Shadow Mastery Decreases Shadowplay skill cooldown -20%. Unlocks once 10 skill points are spent in Shadowplay. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Murderous Intent Wallop, Stalker's Mark, Toxic Shot, Shadowsmite, and Throw Dagger each grant 1 Abyssal Charge whenever they're used. Cannot be upgraded further. Melisara Livolla Assassins of Erenor look to Melisara, the fallen aristocrat and daughter of General Ribola who was hired to kill Gene for his mother's crimes. She is a symbol for completing tasks, and the skills of Shadowplay are attributed to her. Shadowplay is a Utility skill tree built around mobility skills and disables. It stacks Bloodthirst and spends it on Backstab attacks, and it has stealth, leaps and teleports to choose the moment of every fight. It also brings some crowd control and utility of its own, so it works with almost any other tree. Melisara Livolla

Assassins of Erenor look to Melisara, the fallen aristocrat and daughter of General Ribola who was hired to kill Gene for his mother's crimes. She is a symbol for completing tasks, and the skills of Shadowplay are attributed to her.

Shadowplay is a Utility skill tree built around mobility skills and disables. It stacks Bloodthirst and spends it on Backstab attacks, and it has stealth, leaps and teleports to choose the moment of every fight. It also brings some crowd control and utility of its own, so it works with almost any other tree.
